memo: Appearance page has NO Light/Dark 'Mode' row (Linux build: Theme=GTK, buttons 'Use Classic'/'Use QT'). So dark mode likely from chrome://flags #enable-force-dark (Auto Dark Mode for Web Contents). Now clicked address bar; next: type chrome://flags/?search=dark + Enter, set that flag to Disabled. Fallback if flag is Default: click 'Use Classic' on Appearance page.
